title: Whirlbash
blueprint: A 3D spinning-top arena brawler in the io style, solo or online: you and 11 rival tops (real players online, with bots filling empty seats) share a bowl-shaped stadium ringed by bumper walls and open pits. Collect sparks to grow your spin (spin is both health and size), dash into rivals to drain their spin, and shove them into the pits for big ring-out points while arena events (Spark Storm, Arena Tilt, Overdrive) shake things up. Three modes: Endless (climb to #1; a boss, the Champion or the Magnetar, enters after about 2.5 minutes), Last Top Spinning (no respawns, a closing ring, about 3 minutes) and Teams (Blue vs Red, 3-minute rounds, knockouts score for the team, you respawn). Four arenas: the Grand Bowl, the Turntable (a spinning centre disc that recharges spin, plus bumper pillars), the Shutter Ring (six pits, three open at a time, swapping every 9 seconds) and the Orbit Ring (the pits travel round the rim). Online, Last Top and Teams are round-based: countdown, round, results, the next round; late joiners watch until the next one. Six skill power-ups (Blast, Shield, Magnet, Turbo, Anchor, Decoy) must be used within 10 seconds. A player level with XP, level rewards (modes, arenas, parts, level-only paints), three daily missions and personal records give every run a goal; gears unlock crown, core, tip and paint parts in the Garage. Controls: WASD/arrows or mouse to steer, Space or click to dash, E or right click for the power-up, P to pause; touch uses a floating joystick, tap to dash and a power button. A midgame ad plays only when starting a new run from the results screen; an optional rewarded ad doubles the gears earned on the results screen.
description: Spin up your top and battle in a glowing night stadium, solo against 11 rival tops or online against real players, with no account needed. Grab sparks to grow bigger, dash into rivals to drain their spin, and knock them into the open pits for a ring out. Time your charge for a Perfect hit, fire skill power-ups (Blast, Shield, Magnet, Turbo, Anchor and Decoy) within 10 seconds before they fade, and take down the giant boss tops, the Champion and the Magnetar, for a huge bounty. Play Endless to climb to #1, Last Top Spinning where nobody respawns and the ring closes in, or Teams, Blue against Red. Level up to unlock four arenas, finish daily missions, earn trails, climb today's online top 10, play round-based matches with friends in a private room, earn badges and climb the free season track, take on a new rule every week, rate yourself in Ranked, chat with fixed phrases online, and tune music, sound, graphics and accessibility in the settings.

controls.desktop: WASD / Arrow keys or move the mouse to steer. Space or left click: dash. E or right click: use your power-up. P: pause.
controls.mobile: Drag anywhere to steer with the floating joystick. Tap the screen or the bolt button to dash. Tap the power button to use your power-up.

ads.midgame: Only when the player taps 'Play again' on the results screen (between runs, solo or online; the SDK caps it at one every 3 minutes)
ads.rewarded: Optional 'Double gears' button on the results screen, once per run; hidden when ads are unavailable or fail

quality.hook: Compared with Spinner.io, Attack.IO Spins Battle and Super Spinners (endless open arenas where you only grow and bump), Whirlbash is about positioning: the stadium has bumper walls and open pits, so the best plays are ring-outs where you shove a rival into a pit, and timed Perfect charges reward skill. Arena events change the fight every 40 seconds, the #1 top carries a double-points bounty, the Champion boss crashes long runs, four arenas change the rules (a spinning turntable, pits that open and close, pits that travel round the rim), a battle-royale mode closes the ring, a Teams mode pits Blue against Red, and the same arena runs online: Quick Match or a private room with an invite link, no account needed.
quality.onboarding: The first run is a guided tutorial inside real gameplay: four coach cards with key or gesture icons and at most six words each (move, grab the highlighted ring of sparks, dash into a practice top, push rivals toward the pits, with floor chevrons pointing at the nearest pit). Rival bots stay passive and your spin does not decay until it ends, and a Skip button is always visible. From 1.4, one-time tips appear the first time a player meets each newer mechanic: Perfect hits, each boss, the closing ring, Teams, the Turntable, the Shutter Ring and the Orbit Ring (a few words in a card at the bottom, never over menus). A How to Play page (menu, ? button) shows controls, modes, power-ups, bosses, arenas, events and tricks with icons.
quality.art_style: One procedural look: glossy toy-plastic tops built in Three.js from crown, core and tip parts in eight saturated paints, a cobalt bowl stadium with coral/cream bumper walls and hazard-striped pits, a night-indigo sky with light beams and a boxy crowd. The UI uses Lilita One titles, Nunito text and flat inline SVG icons in the same palette. Covers are rendered from the game itself, so the cover, menu and gameplay all match.
quality.content: Three modes: Endless (11 bots of four skill and aggression levels that respawn bigger; two alternating bosses, the Champion and the Magnetar, from about 2.5 minutes), Last Top Spinning (no respawns, a closing ring, placement rewards) and Teams (Blue vs Red, 3-minute rounds, respawns). Four arenas unlocked by level: Grand Bowl, Turntable, Shutter Ring and Orbit Ring (moving pits). Three rotating arena events, six skill power-ups. Progression: player level with rewards at levels 2-15 (modes, arenas, parts, level-only paints and trails), three daily missions from a pool of thirteen, personal records, an Arena of the Day with double XP, 29 garage items (4 crowns, 4 cores, 4 tips, 11 paints, 6 trails). Online: endless rooms plus round-based Last Top and Teams rooms, and a daily top 10 kept by the server. From 1.5: a weekly Endless rule (Spark Rush, Overdrive, Boss Rush, Power Frenzy), ten badges, a free 4-week season track with 20 tiers (season-only Comet trail and Nova paint), Ranked Last Top rounds rated per verified CrazyGames username, arena voting between online rounds, fixed-phrase quick chat, seven music tracks and three announcer voices.
quality.name_check: 'Whirlbash' is an invented word (whirl + bash) that says spinning and smashing. A web search found no game with that name, it uses no words from the spinning-top toy franchises, and it does not read as a plain genre label.
quality.visual_review: Checked menu, gameplay (1216x684 and 800x450 touch), standalone build and all three covers at full size. Fixed: empty leaderboard during the countdown, tutorial coach appearing before the countdown ended, a grey smudge from the floor emblem, bot names too small at 800x450, score and knockout icons looking alike, and a blown-out white blob in the cover clash plus oversized foreground sparks. No T-poses (all tops are procedural and always spinning), no overlapping UI text (every screen sits on an opaque card), and the covers are rendered in-engine so they match the gameplay. Version 1.1: camera follow smoothed (small velocity lead, eased look target, shake capped and smooth instead of random jitter, plus a camera-shake toggle in the pause menu) after a player reported motion sickness on hits and topples; online lobby, room chip and results checked in two-browser tests. Version 1.2: mobile audit at 844x390, 667x375 and 390x844 with touch emulation; fixed a cut-off garage Done button, oversized leaderboard, 30 px pause button, too-close phone camera and tiny labels; touch controls now switch on at the first touch, a quick tap anywhere dashes, and safe-area insets are respected. Version 1.3: checked the menu (level bar, mode and arena pickers with level locks, stat preview) at 1216x684 and 800x450 touch, the Missions screen, the garage hover preview and level-locked paints, results with XP, level-up and record chips, the Turntable disc and pillars, the Shutter Ring doors, the Champion (gold spike crown, boss bar), Anchor and Decoy, and Last Top Spinning. Fixed: the closing ring was too faint (added a red hazard overlay outside the safe zone), the turntable disc was invisible (back faces), floating texts piled up during skipped time, the mission popup covered event banners (moved to the bottom), and bots landing Perfect hits made runs shorter (Perfect is now a player-only skill reward; median bot run is back to about 2 minutes). Version 1.4: checked settings (1216x684 and 800x450 touch), the online lobby with the mode picker, today's top 10 and the name picker (off-platform), spectating a round, round results with the next-round button and today's-board line, Teams (team rings, labels, board bars, score chip, results), the Orbit Ring, the Magnetar's pull, the trail tab. Fixed: a tip card showing under the results card (notices now only appear in play), and the disabled next-round button looking clickable. Version 1.5: checked the menu with the weekly chip, How to Play (desktop and 800x450 touch), settings with the new toggles, the Missions screen with season and badges, colour-blind Teams, the quick-chat menu and bubble. Fixed: How to Play card was see-through and its Done button was cut off (opaque card, header close button), badge progress bars collapsed to zero height.
quality.audio: Announcer lines recorded in three voices (Charlie, Laura, Callum in English; Melek and Ahu in Turkish) with different wording and livelier voice settings, picked at random without repeats; effects and music duck under the announcer. Music: four arena tracks, two showdown tracks and a menu track, a random one each run.

press.headline: {studio} launches Whirlbash, a spinning-top arena brawler playable instantly in the browser
press.summary: Whirlbash drops players into a glowing night stadium with 11 rival spinning tops, solo or online against real players. Grab sparks to grow, dash to clash, and knock rivals into the open pits for a ring out, while arena events, six skill power-ups and two giant boss tops keep every round unpredictable. Three modes (Endless, the battle-royale style Last Top Spinning, and Blue-vs-Red Teams), four arenas, player levels, daily missions and a daily online top 10 give players a goal every time. It runs instantly in any modern browser on desktop and mobile, with no download or account required.
features: Physics clashes: spin is your health and your size, and every hit drains it; a well-timed charge lands a Perfect hit
Three modes: Endless, Last Top Spinning with a closing ring, and Blue-vs-Red Teams
Four arenas: the Grand Bowl, the Turntable, the Shutter Ring and the Orbit Ring where the pits travel round the rim
Two boss tops: the Champion slams the floor, the Magnetar pulls everything in
Six skill power-ups, Blast, Shield, Magnet, Turbo, Anchor and Decoy, but use them within 10 seconds or lose them
Online with no account: Quick Match or a private room, round-based Last Top and Teams, and a daily top 10
Player levels, daily missions, personal records, trails and parts to unlock
A lively announcer: three voices with different lines, plus seven music tracks picked at random
A new rule every week in Endless: Spark Rush, Overdrive, Boss Rush or Power Frenzy
Badges, a free 20-tier season track, and a Ranked mode for CrazyGames players
Settings for music, sound, graphics, camera shake, reduced effects and colour-blind teams; a How to Play page
press.quote: We wanted the thrill of two tops grinding against each other at full speed, and the pits turn every clash into a decision: push now, or wait for the angle.

multiplayer.lobbySize: up to 10 players per room (12 tops; bots fill empty seats)
modes: Quick match: Endless, Last Top or Teams
Private room with invite link or 5-letter code, in any mode
Last Top and Teams are round-based (countdown, round, results, next round)
Ranked: public Last Top rounds rated per verified CrazyGames username
multiplayer.accounts: none required; verified CrazyGames username when logged in, otherwise a name picked from fixed word lists (never typed)
multiplayer.chat: fixed phrases only (six quick-chat lines), rate-limited; no typed text
multiplayer.leaderboard: daily top 10 of server-side online scores

analytics: anonymous per-run counters (mode, arena, length, how it ended, tutorial, power-ups) summed per day on the game server; no identifiers (tools/mp_stats.py)
